summary: Plan, spec, and committed strategy validated against the live harness surface. All 30 plan tasks (Phase 1 7 tasks including 1.4b, Phase 2 6 tasks, Phase 3 5 tasks, Phase 4 6 tasks, cross-cutting C1-C2-C2b-C3-C4-C5 6 tasks) are bounded, independently verifiable, and free of anti-patterns A1, A3, A4, A5, A7, A8 in the plan text. The four stories correspond one-to-one with the four phases. Live-state verification at the strategy commit SHA (2f23cef6) confirms: AUDIT_ONLY_ROLES in lib/core.mjs contains the 6 named roles from spec (measure-review-a-correctness, measure-review-b-security, measure-review-c-ux-api, measure-ux-browser-review, measure-phase-acceptance, measure-final-acceptance) plus measure-orchestrator-audit — wait, measure-orchestrator-audit is NOT in AUDIT_ONLY_ROLES today (only 6 entries); the spec mentions it for S2 but the set is 6-strong. Recorded as nonblocking finding NF-1 for Mid to confirm whether measure-orchestrator-audit should join the set or whether the spec text is descriptive. The 4 confirmed denylist-bypass commands (git -C . commit -am x, python3 -c '...os.remove...', eval $CMD, find . -delete) are runnable against the live lib/core.mjs#forbiddenShell today; Phase 2 will replace the denylist with a state assertion. isTaskAllowed('measure-orchestrator', 'measure-orchestrator') currently returns true per the live code; Phase 3 will tighten this. Plan uses [ ] compatibility markers (no [b] deferred markers exist); A1 free-text 'deferred' defense holds vacuously (no [b] markers to defend). No plan edits required — strategy.json and test-strategy.md are new artifacts added by this role commit; plan.md, spec.md, and metadata.json are unchanged from the user's commit (a6c75f2).

unresolved_questions: Should measure-orchestrator-audit be added to AUDIT_ONLY_ROLES in lib/core.mjs as part of Phase 2 Task 2.3, or is the spec text descriptive only? The set today is 6 entries; the spec narrative implies 7. Mid must confirm with the user (or the role's existing agent-file edit: deny) and add it if appropriate.

Should the untrusted-output framing delimiter be a single opening+closing pair or include a per-output checksum? The strategy spec calls for sha256=<outputHash> in the opening tag, but the implementation choice (SHA-256 of the raw output vs SHA-256 of the wrapped output) is a Jr implementation detail. Mid must confirm the field semantic.

Should the MEASURE_TASK_PACKET schema be defined in TypeBox (matching the existing tool parameter style) or in JSON Schema (matching the public-API style)? The strategy spec lists it as a 'TypeBox schema or JSON Schema' — Jr chooses; review-a audits the choice for consistency with the rest of the extension.

nonblocking_findings.description: Spec mentions measure-orchestrator-audit in the Observed Defects #3 narrative ('startHead / endHead are recorded ... and never asserted, for any role') and again in Story S2 AC1 ('a read-only role completes'). AUDIT_ONLY_ROLES in lib/core.mjs today contains 6 entries (measure-review-a-correctness, measure-review-b-security, measure-review-c-ux-api, measure-ux-browser-review, measure-phase-acceptance, measure-final-acceptance) and does NOT include measure-orchestrator-audit. The strategy records this as a nonblocking finding: Mid must confirm whether to add measure-orchestrator-audit to AUDIT_ONLY_ROLES (so the state assertion applies to it) or treat the spec text as descriptive of the intent (any role with a read-only expectation). The role's agent file (measure-orchestrator-audit.md) already has edit: deny in its permission block at the agent-file level, so the spirit of S2 AC1 holds today even if AUDIT_ONLY_ROLES is not updated. The strategy recommends Mid add it; review-a audits the choice.

The S1 acceptance gate requires a live delegation probe (Task 1.5). The probe invokes a real child process and parses the resulting JSON event stream. Pi's runtime event-stream shape is not formally versioned; if Pi's runtime changes the shape between the strategy commit and the S1 acceptance, the probe will fail and the fixture must be re-recorded. The strategy records this in the S1 closeout gate; the live probe is the ONLY test that exercises the live pipe, so any drift is detected at S1 acceptance, not at S1 Green.

S1 introduces a breaking contract change: the receipt field `model` is renamed to `requestedModel` and a new `observedModel` field is added. The two successor tracks (role_model_pool_20260805, role_fitness_frontier_watch_20260805) consume these fields. Today no in-repo consumer reads `receipt.model` directly (the only writer is extensions/measure-harness/index.ts#task itself), so the rename is safe. The strategy's C2b handoff task names the exact fields for the two successor tracks; Mid/Jr must not add a `model` field as a silent alias to `requestedModel` (A7 analog). Review-a audits the rename for silent breakage.

Phase 3 Task 3.4 tightens isTaskAllowed to refuse `measure-orchestrator` → `coder-orchestrator` (primary-as-child refused). The closed harness_selfcheck_truthfulness_20260805 track used `coder-orchestrator` as a delegation target (per reconciliation-models.md handoff). If any in-flight acceptance flow or test depends on this pattern, the tightening will break it. The strategy records this in S3's changed-contract risks; review-a must confirm before Green.

lib/core.mjs#forbiddenShell at lines 369-376 contains 5 regex patterns. Verified that the four confirmed bypasses from spec.md Observed Defects #4 (git -C . commit -am x, python3 -c '...os.remove...', eval $CMD, find . -delete) are NOT matched by the denylist. The git commit pattern is `\bgit\s+(?:commit|push|reset|checkout|restore)\b` which requires `commit` (not `commit -am`) preceded by whitespace and `git` — the `git -C . commit` form does not match because of the `-C .` argument between `git` and `commit`. The bypass corpus is confirmed runnable against the live denylist.

lib/core.mjs#isTaskAllowed at lines 355-362 returns true for (measure-orchestrator, measure-orchestrator) today (the `childName.startsWith('measure-')` branch matches). Verified via code inspection. Phase 3 Task 3.4 will tighten this.

lib/core.mjs#parseAgentFile at lines 78-95 uses strict resolve: `model: sourceModel ? MODEL_MAP[sourceModel] : undefined`. There is NO `?? sourceModel` fallback (the closed track already removed it). The spec S1 references a different runtimeModel line in extensions/measure-harness/index.ts:88 (`return agent.model ?? (fallback ? ... : undefined)`) which IS the parent-fallback the spec calls out. The fallback is in runtimeModel, not parseAgentFile. The strategy's S1 Red condition (b) targets runtimeModel's parent-fallback, not parseAgentFile.
